reasons: comparator-promise-table-replace: The cited membership theorem has different numbering in the official proceedings and arXiv appendix. The replacement names both versions explicitly and also labels the proceedings location for the fiber-isomorphism comparison.

narrow: The former transition `More precisely' treated the maximum-indegree-three restriction as though it were the full literal class at \(k=0\). The condition \(K_G=0\) excludes only indegree-two vertices and still permits indegree at least four, whereas the subproblem \(\mathcal R_0\) additionally lies in the promise domain of \(\mathsf{NUMEDGE}_3\). The replacement preserves both true completeness conclusions while making containment, hardness, and membership separate.

verdict.note: Accepted both after math audit: the full K_G=0 class and R0 restriction are now proved separately with containment only, and source numbering is version-qualified.
